_comment: The client's register of external sources that procurement and legal have looked at. Being listed here does NOT mean a source is usable: check agreement_status, then read the provider's terms yourself (terms_url). Licence fields are deliberately left for the agent to establish. Other external datasets are not listed: the human supplies them as dataset links at the candidate gate, under the open-data policy below.

sources.title: Open-data policy for dataset links supplied by analysts
sources.notes: Legal allows publicly available datasets (repositories such as UCI or Zenodo, statistics offices, open-data portals) for prototyping, benchmarking and context, subject to each dataset's own licence as read at its source. Datasets behind a login, with an unknown licence or a non-commercial licence need Legal review before use. Production use of any external dataset needs Legal sign-off.
